lines.en: Mia, do you ever wonder what your life would have been like? If I had taken that job in London, I’d have moved abroad.
lines.pt: Mia, você já se perguntou como sua vida teria sido? Se eu tivesse aceitado aquele emprego em Londres, teria me mudado para o exterior.

lines.en: All the time. If I hadn’t turned down the offer in Madrid, I would have learned Spanish properly by now.
lines.pt: O tempo todo. Se eu não tivesse recusado a proposta em Madri, já teria aprendido espanhol direito.

lines.en: Would you have gone alone? I think I would have been homesick, even if the salary had been fantastic.
lines.pt: Você teria ido sozinha? Acho que eu teria sentido saudade de casa, mesmo que o salário fosse fantástico.

lines.en: Maybe not. If my sister hadn’t been pregnant, I would have said yes immediately. Family was the problem.
lines.pt: Talvez não. Se minha irmã não estivesse grávida, eu teria dito sim na hora. A família foi o problema.

lines.en: I understand. If my work permit had been approved on time, I might have accepted. The delay ruined everything.
lines.pt: Entendo. Se minha autorização de trabalho tivesse saído a tempo, eu poderia ter aceitado. O atraso estragou tudo.

lines.en: What a shame. If you had taken the plunge, you could have been living in a new city, with new friends.
lines.pt: Que pena. Se você tivesse se arriscado, poderia estar morando numa cidade nova, com novos amigos.

lines.en: True, but if I had left, I wouldn’t have met Carlos. We would never have started our business here in Miami.
lines.pt: Verdade, mas se eu tivesse ido, não teria conhecido o Carlos. Nunca teríamos aberto nosso negócio aqui em Miami.

lines.en: See? That setback led to something fulfilling. If it hadn’t happened, you wouldn’t be so happy today.
lines.pt: Viu? Aquele contratempo levou a algo gratificante. Se não tivesse acontecido, você não estaria tão feliz hoje.

lines.en: And you? If you had seized the opportunity in Madrid, would you have become a manager already?
lines.pt: E você? Se tivesse aproveitado a oportunidade em Madri, já teria virado gerente?

lines.en: Possibly. But if I had gone, I wouldn’t have had time for my niece. I can not say which life would have been better.
lines.pt: Possivelmente. Mas se eu tivesse ido, não teria tido tempo para minha sobrinha. Não sei dizer qual vida teria sido melhor.

lines.en: Nobody can. Let us stop imagining the past and plan a trip together. If we save now, we’ll visit Madrid next spring.
lines.pt: Ninguém sabe. Vamos parar de imaginar o passado e planejar uma viagem juntas. Se economizarmos agora, visitaremos Madri na primavera.

items.wrong: If I would have taken the job, I would have moved.
items.fix: If I had taken the job, I would have moved.
items.why: In the if-clause of the third conditional, use had + participle.

items.wrong: If I had took the job, I would have moved.
items.fix: If I had taken the job, I would have moved.
items.why: Use the past participle: taken, not took.

items.wrong: If she hadn’t been late, she would have meet him.
items.fix: If she hadn’t been late, she would have met him.
items.why: After would have, use the past participle.

facts.big: if + had + particípio, would have + particípio
facts.label: 3º condicional
facts.sub: Passado imaginado: If I had taken that job, I’d have moved abroad. Negativa: If I hadn’t… I wouldn’t have…

facts.label: A condição
facts.sub: No 3º condicional, a condição usa had + particípio: If I had taken that job… Ela fala de algo que não aconteceu. Em português: “se eu tivesse aceitado…”. Não use would na condição.

facts.label: O resultado
facts.sub: O resultado imaginado usa would have + particípio: I would have moved abroad. Forma curta: I’d have moved. Could have e might have mostram possibilidade em vez de certeza.

facts.label: Duas orações

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: If + had + participle describes an imaginary past condition.
items.why: Yes.

items.s: We say “If I would have taken”.
items.why: We say If I had taken.

items.s: Would have + participle is the result.
items.why: Yes.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

answers: If + had + participle describes an imaginary past condition. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “If I would have taken”. → Falso (We say If I had taken.)
Would have + participle is the result. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

paragraphs: It is a sunny evening in Miami. Fern and Mia sit by the water. Palm trees move in the breeze. The two friends are thinking about the past. Both once received job offers abroad. Neither of them left.

“Mia, do you ever wonder what your life would have been like? If I had taken that job in London, I’d have moved abroad.” says Fern. “All the time. If I hadn’t turned down the offer in Madrid, I would have learned Spanish properly by now.” says Mia. “Would you have gone alone? I think I would have been homesick, even if the salary had been fantastic.” says Fern.

pages.title: Conversa · começo
lines: Fern
Mia, do you ever wonder what your life would have been like? If I had taken that job in London, I’d have moved abroad.
Mia, você já se perguntou como sua vida teria sido? Se eu tivesse aceitado aquele emprego em Londres, teria me mudado para o exterior.
You
All the time. If I hadn’t turned down the offer in Madrid, I would have learned Spanish properly by now.
O tempo todo. Se eu não tivesse recusado a proposta em Madri, já teria aprendido espanhol direito.
Fern
Would you have gone alone? I think I would have been homesick, even if the salary had been fantastic.
Você teria ido sozinha? Acho que eu teria sentido saudade de casa, mesmo que o salário fosse fantástico.
You
Maybe not. If my sister hadn’t been pregnant, I would have said yes immediately. Family was the problem.
Talvez não. Se minha irmã não estivesse grávida, eu teria dito sim na hora. A família foi o problema.
Fern
I understand. If my work permit had been approved on time, I might have accepted. The delay ruined everything.
Entendo. Se minha autorização de trabalho tivesse saído a tempo, eu poderia ter aceitado. O atraso estragou tudo.
You
What a shame. If you had taken the plunge, you could have been living in a new city, with new friends.
Que pena. Se você tivesse se arriscado, poderia estar morando numa cidade nova, com novos amigos.

pages.title: Conversa · final
lines: Fern
True, but if I had left, I wouldn’t have met Carlos. We would never have started our business here in Miami.
Verdade, mas se eu tivesse ido, não teria conhecido o Carlos. Nunca teríamos aberto nosso negócio aqui em Miami.
You
See? That setback led to something fulfilling. If it hadn’t happened, you wouldn’t be so happy today.
Viu? Aquele contratempo levou a algo gratificante. Se não tivesse acontecido, você não estaria tão feliz hoje.
Fern
And you? If you had seized the opportunity in Madrid, would you have become a manager already?
E você? Se tivesse aproveitado a oportunidade em Madri, já teria virado gerente?
You
Possibly. But if I had gone, I wouldn’t have had time for my niece. I can not say which life would have been better.
Possivelmente. Mas se eu tivesse ido, não teria tido tempo para minha sobrinha. Não sei dizer qual vida teria sido melhor.
Fern
Nobody can. Let us stop imagining the past and plan a trip together. If we save now, we’ll visit Madrid next spring.
Ninguém sabe. Vamos parar de imaginar o passado e planejar uma viagem juntas. Se economizarmos agora, visitaremos Madri na primavera.
